verdict.rationale: Task 10 static top-level import of ./terminal.js breaks setup-driver.test.mjs (terminal.js reads window.__TAURI__.core at module scope, unstubbed); needs lazy import or DI. Task 9 correlation-id test is a no-op (assert.ok(true)) - id filtering already happens in runner-bridge.js, criterion needs rewriting to something real (late-arriving data after settle is ignored) or dropped. Task 3 test has a dead 'require ? undefined : undefined' line that throws in ESM - delete it. onLog is in the contract/constraints but has no task. Generic 'input' path (credential, codemieUrl) has no real handling - only profileName covered. Task 7's unrecognized-prompt fallback has no trigger for a second read/settle-detection when no more PTY data arrives - needs a defined mechanism (e.g. idle timer) or the run can hang.

Nothing dedupes repeat detection of the same in-flight or already-answered prompt. onData fires per PTY chunk, inquirer sends multiple chunks per prompt, and onPrompt is awaited - a chunk arriving while awaiting can re-detect the same prompt and call onPrompt a second time / double-write the answer. Need an in-flight/already-answered guard per prompt plus a check that the screen has actually moved on before accepting the next detection. Also tighten Task 3's onLog test to assert writes, not just log call count, since that's the test that would have caught the double-answer.

Dedup guard (signature-before-await, pagination-walk exempt) is correct. Watch item flagged for build time, not a plan blocker: if the CLI redraws an unchanged-message error state after a rejected credential answer, the equality-keyed signature would ignore it forever - if reachable, fix is to clear the signature once the screen has changed post-write rather than purely on equality. Not building that now unless something actually hits it.
